summary: CR-385 Phase 0.5 QA RUN A — verified the 5 fixes (BUG-437 D70, BUG-434, BUG-435 D71, BUG-436, BUG-438) at /pms/front-desk-v2 via a single Playwright script against preprod. 8/10 cases PASS. Two FAILs: BUG-435 Case C (focus refresh after >5s does not fire a request) and BUG-434 recovery/rooms path (recovery timed out because after unroute the retry click did not re-render fd-tab-strip within 45s and the rooms error flow could not proceed). Zero non-ignored console errors captured.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG-435 D71 Case C FAIL — after a completed fetch, waiting 6.5 s idle then dispatching a single window 'focus' event does NOT trigger a new /aiosell/local-reservations request (observed 0, expected exactly 1). Case A (two focus events within 2 s of last fetch → 0) trivially passes so cannot alone confirm the listener fires; Case D (manual click) works, so the fetch pipeline is healthy. Root-cause suspicion: the focus listener/onFocus branch or lastFetchRef comparison isn't re-arming — either the debounce window is longer than the spec's 5 s, the listener is attached to a wrong target, or a subsequent event (e.g. visibilitychange) is required. Also verified: a synthetic `visibilitychange` after making document.visibilityState='visible' also yields 0 new requests.

BUG-434 recovery FAIL — after fulfilling /aiosell/local-reservations with 500 and clicking fd-retry-btn (in-flight state passed: disabled + 'Retrying…' + exactly 1 request), unroute()-ing the mock and clicking fd-retry-btn a second time did NOT bring back [data-testid='fd-tab-strip'] within 45 s. Screenshot shows the app remained on the error card with a different message ('Request timed out. Check your connection and try again.'). This blocked the subsequent rooms-error scenario (fd-rooms-error/fd-rooms-retry-btn) because tabs were not rendered.

action_items: BUG-435 D71 Case C: investigate why the window 'focus' listener in useFrontDeskSnapshot does not fire a new /aiosell/local-reservations after >5 s idle. Verify onFocus is subscribed to the correct target (window vs document), that lastFetchRef is compared correctly (< 5000 ms not <= or reversed), and that inFlightRef is nulled before the debounce window elapses. Confirm the RTL D71 unit tests (BUG-435 named export) still assert the third scenario.

BUG-434 recovery: after fulfilling 500, unroute()-ing, and clicking fd-retry-btn, the app must re-fetch and render fd-tab-strip. Currently it stays on fd-page-error with 'Request timed out'. Likely inFlightRef isn't cleared correctly, or the request AbortController is being reused, or refresh() short-circuits when a prior error is present. This also blocks the rooms retry sub-flow.

Consider adding an explicit data-testid on the Phone <td> cell (e.g. fd-row-<id>-phone) — currently the phone cell has no dedicated testid; tests must scan cell text. Not a bug fix, just testability improvement referenced by the QA spec.
critical_code_review_comments: FrontDeskWorkstationPage.jsx L47: `inFlightRef.current = null` runs in `finally`, but if an error is thrown the setError path clears refreshing and inFlightRef — subsequent retry clicks may re-enter but the app appears not to actually re-fetch after unroute. Add trace/log for retry click paths.

FrontDeskWorkstationPage.jsx L53: focus debounce uses Date.now() - lastFetchRef.current < 5000, but lastFetchRef only advances on SUCCESS (L43). If the last fetch errored, lastFetchRef stays at previous value → after a long time focus will trigger a fetch; verify this is what Case C exercises in practice.
GuestTable.jsx L115: Phone column render has no data-testid attribute; add fd-row-<id>-phone to enable deterministic selection called out in the spec.

rca of the issue: BUG-435 Case C: focus-triggered auto-refresh does not fire after the 5 s debounce window. onFocus in useFrontDeskSnapshot (L53) references lastFetchRef, which is only advanced on a successful fetch. The listener itself might not be attached to the correct target for synthetic events, or the debounce comparison is inverted for the exact 5000 ms boundary. Repro: (1) load /pms/front-desk-v2, wait for tab-strip, (2) click fd-refresh-btn, wait networkidle, (3) sleep 6500 ms, (4) `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'))`, wait 5000 ms → observed 0 /aiosell/local-reservations, expected 1. BUG-434 recovery: after 500-mock unroute + retry click, refresh() is invoked but the app stays on the error card and shows a new 'Request timed out' message, implying inFlightRef/AbortController state or React error boundary is not being reset. Mitigation: force setError(null) at the start of refresh(), null out inFlightRef defensively before invoking, and add an integration test that mounts, injects a 500, then a 200, then asserts snap becomes non-null.
